Patrol Leader《Hmm... But if that rigid bastard of a general accuses us of neglecting our duties, who will listen to that?》
Patrol Member B《Then shall we finish them? We've got the better position.》
Patrol Leader《Yes... all right. Leave one.》
Patrol Leader《Hunt the rest.》
Patrol Member A《Understood.》
Patrol Member B《Ha ha... rabbit hunt, bhai!》

en.html:
Regional General"What? One of our dragoon patrol platoons has lost contact? Every single craft?"
Regional General"...An enormous enemy force wiped them out before they could report? No, that cannot be it. If so, why have none of the other patrols noticed its movements?"
Regional General"Tch! Neglecting their duties, then! Win a little and straightaway the bloody bastards go slack. What can you do with such fools...!"

ja.html:
方面将軍「何？ 　警邏の竜騎兵小隊が一つ、音信途絶だと？ 全騎か？」
方面将軍「……敵の大軍に襲われて連絡を寄越す間も なく全滅した、はずはないな。 　もしそうなら他の警邏隊が動静をつかんで いないのは不自然だ」
方面将軍「くっ、ということは単なる職務怠慢か！ 　少し勝つとすぐだらけおって、これだから 馬鹿は度し難い……！」
